تياسرت (form VI)
# تَيَاسَرْتُ (tayāsartu) /ta.jaː.sar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تَيَاسَرْتَ (tayāsarta) /ta.jaː.sar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تَيَاسَرْتِ (tayāsarti) /ta.jaː.sar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تَيَاسَرَتْ (tayāsarat) /ta.jaː.sa.rat/: third-person fem
